description:
A beautifully presented and versatile three bedroom detached family home, occupying a generous plot and boasting an exceptional south facing rear garden complete with a charming 'secret garden'.

Originally built as a bungalow in 1957, the property was thoughtfully extended into the loft just over 10 years ago, creating two impressive additional bedrooms, a master en-suite and a stunning Juliet balcony overlooking the rear garden. The current owners have continued to redesign and renovate the home to an exceptionally high standard, creating a stylish and versatile family residence.

Approached via a architect-designed driveway, completed in 2024, the property immediately impresses with its elevated position, excellent kerb appeal and generous off road parking for up to four vehicles.

On entering, a welcoming hallway with exposed floorboards provides access to the principal accommodation. To the front is a lovely lounge featuring a beautiful bay window, flooding the room with natural light and creating the perfect space to relax and unwind. Also on the ground floor is bedroom three, a versatile room which would make an ideal guest bedroom, young adult's room, home office or hobbies room. The main living accommodation is positioned towards the rear of the property, making the most of the wonderful views over the garden. The impressive open-plan family and dining room provides a fantastic space for entertaining and socialising, with French doors opening directly onto the rear garden. The modern fitted kitchen is located just off the dining area and benefits from side access and lovely views over the garden.

A beautifully appointed family bathroom completes the ground floor and features underfloor heating. The bathroom was refitted in 2021.

Upstairs, there are two further generous double bedrooms. The principal bedroom is a particularly impressive space, featuring a Juliet balcony overlooking the garden, creating a wonderful spot to enjoy your morning coffee. The room also benefits from a walk-in wardrobe, en-suite shower room and excellent eaves storage with lighting. Bedroom two is another excellent-sized double bedroom with ample space for furniture and a desk, making it ideal for family members of all ages.

Without doubt, one of the standout features of this exceptional home is the rear garden. Professionally landscaped and lovingly developed over the past decade, the southerly facing garden is arranged into three distinct sections and provides an incredible sense of privacy and tranquillity.

A patio seating area immediately outside the French doors leads onto beautifully manicured lawns, continuing through to the enchanting 'secret garden'. This secluded area provides a wonderfully private setting for outdoor dining, entertaining or simply relaxing and enjoying the surroundings.

The garden features an impressive variety of mature planting, including flowering cherries, magnolias, fuchsias, spring bulbs and Japanese acers which provide spectacular autumn colour. Exeter's mild climate also allows for a wonderful selection of more tender plants, including agapanthus, banana plants, fuchsia and schefflera. It is a truly special garden and a rare opportunity to enjoy such a beautiful outdoor space within the city. There is also a useful outbuilding currently utilised as a utility room, together with a summer house which can be enjoyed throughout the year. The garage benefits from power and lighting and incorporates a useful workshop area.

Honiton Road is ideally positioned for access into Exeter city centre, whilst also providing excellent routes out of the city, making this a superb location for commuters. The property is conveniently situated close to the RD&E Hospital, Met Office, highly regarded primary schools and the sought-after St Peter's School. An exceptional home offering versatile accommodation, outstanding gardens and an enviable location, this is a property that truly needs to be viewed to be appreciated.

Council Tax Band: D
Tenure: Freehold
